interface.signature: canConvertString(s: str, t: str, k: int) -> bool

postconditions.description: The lengths of s and t are within the specified bounds, and k is within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
postconditions.description: Both s and t contain only lowercase English letters.
